86	    if (reg == kAbstractcs && (value & kCmderrMask) != 0u)
87	      cmderr_sticky_ = false;  // W1C clear
88	    if (reg == kCommand && fail_csr_write) {
89	      const auto regno    = static_cast<uint16_t>(value & 0xFFFFu);
90	      const bool is_write = ((value >> 16) & 1u) != 0u;
91	      if (is_write && regno == hybrid::regno_csr(*fail_csr_write))
92	        cmderr_sticky_ = true;
93	    }
94	    if (reg == kCommand && value != hybrid::kExecProgbufCmd) {
95	      const auto regno    = static_cast<uint16_t>(value & 0xFFFFu);
96	      const bool is_write = ((value >> 16) & 1u) != 0u;
97	      if (is_write) {
98	        if (!warl_ignore.count(regno))
99	          regfile[regno] = (uint64_t{staged_data1_} << 32) | staged_data0_;
100	      } else {
101	        const auto it = regfile.find(regno);
102	        const uint64_t v = (it == regfile.end()) ? 0u : it->second;
103	        pending_data0_ = static_cast<uint32_t>(v);
104	        pending_data1_ = static_cast<uint32_t>(v >> 32);
105	      }
106	    }
107	    if (reg == kCommand && value == hybrid::kExecProgbufCmd
108	        && fail_next_pb_exec) {
109	      cmderr_sticky_ = true;
110	      fail_next_pb_exec = false;
111	    }
112	  }
113	
114	  auto read(uint8_t reg) -> uint32_t override
115	  {
116	    ops.push_back({DmiOp::Kind::Read, reg, 0});
117	    if (reg == kDmstatus) return dmstatus_value;
118	    if (reg == kData0)   return pending_data0_;
119	    if (reg == kData1)   return pending_data1_;
120	    if (reg == kAbstractcs) {
121	      if (cmderr_sticky_) return kCmderrMask;
122	      if (!abstractcs_queue.empty()) {
123	        auto v = abstractcs_queue.front();
124	        abstractcs_queue.pop_front();
125	        return v;
126	      }
127	      return abstractcs_value;
128	    }
129	    return 0;
130	  }

132	private:
133	  static constexpr uint32_t kCmderrMask = 0x7u << 8;
134	  bool cmderr_sticky_ = false;
135	  uint32_t staged_data0_  = 0;
136	  uint32_t staged_data1_  = 0;
137	  uint32_t pending_data0_ = 0;
138	  uint32_t pending_data1_ = 0;

952	  //     base (v0/v8/v16/v24) covers 8 registers. The 4 loads land in any slot
953	  //     of the single grouped Program-Buffer execution.
954	  auto in_progbuf = [](const DmiOp& op, uint32_t insn) {

964	    std::optional<std::size_t> at;

966	      if (in_progbuf(bus.ops[i], want)) { at = i; break; }

969	    if (!last_vle_idx  || *at > *last_vle_idx)  last_vle_idx  = at;

976	  //     write (the scratch base); the in-buffer addi advances it per register,

24	inline constexpr uint8_t kProgbuf0 = 0x20u;

26	// Max payload instructions: 16 total slots minus 1 reserved for the
27	// mandatory ebreak that terminates execution.
28	inline constexpr std::size_t kProgbufMaxInsns = 15u;
29

34	//   cmdtype  = 0 (Access Register)
35	//   aarsize  = Bits64 (3) - ignored by DM when transfer=0, set for consistency
36	//   postexec = 1 (bit 18)
37	//   transfer = 0 (bit 17 NOT set) - skip register I/O, only run progbuf
38	//   write    = 0 (irrelevant when transfer=0)
39	//   regno    = 0 (irrelevant when transfer=0)
40	inline constexpr uint32_t kExecProgbufCmd =
41	    (uint32_t(AarSize::Bits64) & 0x7u) << 20 | (1u << 18);
42	
43	// Encode `csrrw rd, csr, rs1` (SYSTEM opcode, funct3=001).
44	// Tier-A PB fallback: stage the CSR value in rs1 via Abstract Command,
45	// then write it to a CSR that the DM cannot reach via abstract access.
46	inline constexpr uint32_t encode_csrrw(uint8_t rd, uint16_t csr, uint8_t rs1)
47	{
48	    return ((uint32_t(csr) & 0xFFFu) << 20)
49	         | ((uint32_t(rs1) & 0x1Fu) << 15)
50	         | (0b001u << 12)
51	         | ((uint32_t(rd)  & 0x1Fu) << 7)
